lock.notice: The public walkway over Benson Weir is currently closed. A diversion is signposted.

crew.directions: From the A4074 (Oxford to Reading road), turn west to access Preston Crowmarsh. Follow the footpath over the footbridge and the weir walkway to the lock. The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line. The public walkway over Benson Weir is currently closed. You can access Benson Lock from the west bank. Follow the towpath north and upstream from Wallingford Bridge.
crew.parking: There is no car parking at the lock. You may park on the roadside where local restrictions permit.

crew.directions: Follow the B4009 to the Goring on Thames side of Goring and Streatley Bridge. From the High Street, turn south on to Lock Approach. Follow Lock Approach to the river and turn right. Follow the path north and upstream to the lock. The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line.
crew.parking: There is no car parking at the lock. You may park in the Wheel Orchard Car Park in Goring village (approximately half a mile from the lock). No toilets are available at the lock. The nearest toilets are at the Wheel Orchard Car Park in Goring village (approximately half a mile from the lock).

crew.directions: From the A4155 (Reading to Henley road), turn east onto Mill Lane. Follow the footpath south to the lock. The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line.
crew.parking: There is no car parking at the lock. You should not park on Mill Lane beyond the lock access path as this is private. You may park on the roadside where local restrictions permit.

lock.notice: Marsh Horse Bridge upstream of Marsh Lock is currently closed. A diversion is signposted.

crew.directions: From the A4130 (Henley to Maidenhead road), turn north at Hurley Bottom onto the road marked Hurley village only. Follow the road to its end. Follow the footpath and pedestrian signs to the lock (approximately 0.1 miles). The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line.
crew.parking: There is no car parking at the lock. You may use the public car park in Hurley village.

lock.notice: Temple Footbridge upstream of Temple Lock is currently closed. A diversion is signposted.

crew.directions: From the A4094, turn east onto Odney Lane. Cross the humpback bridge at the end of the lane. Cross through Odney Common by footpath to Odney Weir. Cross the weir walkway and the footbridge. Turn right to follow the footpath downstream to the lock. The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line.
crew.parking: There is car parking at the lock available for blue badge holders. Please speak to the lock keeper at least one day prior to visiting. You will need to check availability and request vehicle access across the common. You may park on the roadside in Odney Lane and nearby where local restrictions permit. Toilets are available at the lock. Wheelchair accessible toilets are available next to the car parking spaces. You will need a RADAR key.

lock.notice: Please note there is a beam width restriction of approximately 2.6 metres (8’ 6”) for the electric charging point

crew.directions: From the A308 (Old Windsor to Staines road), turn north at Egham. From the A30-A308 roundabout, follow the footpath that leads left from the northbound slip-road of the M25. Turn left at the river and follow the towpath north-west and upstream to the lock. From Runnymede Pleasure Ground, follow the towpath south-east and downstream to the lock. These routes are marked on the map with green dashed lines.
crew.parking: There is no car parking at the lock. You may park in Egham where local restrictions permit. There is a public car park off the A308 road at Runnymede Pleasure Ground (approximately half a mile from the lock).

crew.directions: From the B376 (Laleham to Shepperton road), turn west towards the river. Follow Beech Tree Lane to the towpath (Thames Side). Follow the towpath to the lock. The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line.
crew.parking: There is car parking at the lock allocated for blue badge holders. Please speak to the lock keeper in advance to check availability. Other users may park on the roadside where local restrictions permit. You should not park on Beech Tree Lane or Thames Side as these are private.

crew.directions: From the A3050 (Hurst Road or Riverbank Road), turn north-west onto Waterside Drive and follow the road round to the right. The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line.
crew.parking: There is car parking at the lock for one permit holder. Please speak to the lock keeper in advance to check availability. You may park in the surrounding area or at the adjacent leisure centre where local restrictions permit.

lock.notice: Please note that Molesey water point is currently out of use until further notice due to a burst water pipe.

crew.directions: From the A3050 (Hurst Road or Riverbank Road), follow the footpath from the war memorial towards the river. The route is marked on the map with a green dashed line.
crew.parking: There is no car parking at the lock. You may park on the roadside where local restrictions permit.
